benchmark_evidence.notes: Score originates from the third-party Arena.ai leaderboard (announced in the official Qwen weibo article), hence benchmark_owner_reported rather than vendor-run; no protocol fields printed (all null), no vote count given. 提升22分夺冠: leaderboard image (images/01.png, vision-read, notes-only per §12.5) shows prior version Qwen3.8-Max at #4 1,669 — consistent with 1669→1691; Qwen's official X post states 'jumps from 1669 to 1691'. The article separately cites the CodeArena price-performance board (帕累托前沿): new version ~$5/M blended average, while the #2/#3 models cost $20 and $12 per M (image 02 tooltip vision-read: $5.00/M blended price, 3:1 ratio) — 综合均价口径, not input/output split; platform list price (¥12/¥36) recorded in models[].pricing instead. Naming note: prose says 'CodeArena 前端编程总榜', leaderboard image title reads 'Code Arena: WebDev'; mapped to the existing entity code-arena-frontend (established id from seed-2-1), label discrepancy left for the owner to adjudicate. Third-party corroboration: Arena.ai's official LinkedIn post 'debuted at #1 overall in Code Arena: WebDev with 1691 pts, highest-scoring model on the Pareto front'. Also in-article claim (vendor assertion, not a row): 多步推理、工具调用、端到端 app 生成刷新全球模型新上限.

notes: 日期证据链（双 A 级）：微博官方文章 publishedTime 2026-09-02 11:22:12（正文自述'今天'）+ 千问平台模型页别名 qwen3.8-max-2026-09-02 同日；IT之家/新浪财经/搜狐/网易 2026-09-02 当日转述互证（媒体仅日期佐证，D 级）。与 2026-08-03 发布的关系：平台模型页自述本版本'是 qwen3.8-max 的快照版本'，公告称 1 个月前发布并开源 Qwen3.8-Max——作为后训练更新独立建档，参照 kimi-k2-0905 先例；qwen3-8-max.json 保持只读未动。抓取路径：微博文章 curl 即得内嵌全文（非 JS 壳），web reader 双路径一致，公告全文逐字转录进 models/2026-09-02-qwen3-8-max-0902/index.md（另存 weibo-article.html）；模型页派单 URL（连字符 qwen3-8-max-0902）404，按公告正文内链接点号 qwen3.8-max-0902 抓取成功（HTTP 200），本 release 的 models 页证据以点号 URL 为准。models[] 规格口径：params（2.4T/95B 激活 MoE）0902 公告与模型页均未重述，沿用 2026-08-03 官方发布口径并在 variant 注明；context_window '1M' 为 0902 模型页明示（定价区限速表'上下文 1M'、meta 自述'延续 100 万上下文'）；modalities 沿用 08-03 三模态口径，0902 页面'视觉理解全面精进……多模态感知'自述佐证。非评测要点：已上线千问AI平台 API，接入千问办公、Qoder、千问APP。未入账本的证据线索：公告图 3（images/03.png）内嵌 17 项 benchmark 对比表（TerminalBench 3.0 / DeepSWE 1.1 / NL2Repo-Bench / ProgramBench / SWE-Marathon / MLS-Bench-Lite / SWE-Atlas QnA / QwenSWEBench V2 / CoWorkBench / JobBench / Automation Bench v1.0.6 / Toolathlon Verified / WorkArena Elo / MMMU-Pro / ERQA / ClawEval-MM / BabyVision，列 Qwen3.8-Max-0902 | Qwen3.8-Max | Claude-Opus-5 | Fable5 | GPT5.6 Sol，附 12 条协议脚注，含 Claude Code harness、temp 1.0、top_p 0.95、超时 5-12h、max_tokens 64000-128000、1M 上下文、mini-SWE-agent 等），为图片形态——按 §12.5 视觉转写只存归档 index.md，行未入账本，待人工读图确认后补行（最高优先级补行机会，locator: 文章内嵌图 images/03.png）；图 1（榜单）/图 2（帕累托）视觉读数同样只进 notes 与 index.md。
